description: This file defines the 'EffectedPermissions' interface, which manages permissions in the context of permission effects such as grant and revoke within the policies model. It includes methods for creating instances, retrieving permissions based on effects, and JSON serialization support.

classes.name: JsonFields
classes.description: Contains JSON field definitions for EffectedPermissions, including schema version, grant permissions, and revoke permissions.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new EffectedPermissions instance with specified granted and revoked permissions.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves permissions corresponding to a specified PermissionEffect (grant or revoke).

methods.name: getGrantedPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves the permissions that are granted.

methods.name: getRevokedPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves the permissions that are revoked.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the EffectedPermissions to a JSON object including only non-hidden fields.
